title: Return only requested coverage areas in caller order
preconditions: Use coveredSaga and cover all six changed implementation lines; leave stories incomplete.

steps.expected_result: Only two areas are returned in exactly stories,implementation order and covered=false.

steps.action: Run check --covers implementation,stories in text mode.
steps.expected_result: Output describes the story gap and does not include personas or Next actions.

steps.action: Repeat with selected permutations of design,quality,health,personas and compare returned names to requested names.
steps.expected_result: Each supported requested area is returned once in requested order; unrelated gaps do not decide result.

expected_result: The check answers exactly the selected documentation questions.
